Hello Travel Lifestyle,
My name is Loyd, and I’m one of your subscribers. I really enjoy the travel content you create and the way you present your videos.
I’m a video editor who creates similar travel and documentary-style content, and I understand how much time it can take to research, write, edit, and put together a high-quality video.
I’ve studied your channel and the style you use for your scripts, narration, visuals, and overall videos. I believe I could help you produce more content without compromising the quality of your videos.
I’d love to offer to make your next 3 videos completely free so you can see the quality of my work and decide whether I’d be a good fit for your channel.
If you’re happy with the results, we could then discuss working together on a regular basis. My goal would be to help you increase your upload frequency, potentially allowing you to publish more consistently, even daily, while you focus on growing the channel.
